title: WHAT IS LOST IN POST-TRAINING? DEFAULT COLLAPSE AND THE LOSS OF IN-CONTEXT STEERABILITY ACROSS DIVERSE PERSPECTIVES

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning models toward one pole of Hofstede's cultural dimensions (via the CDEval dataset) and measuring default collapse and in-context steerability loss using multiple-choice and free-form text evaluation by an LLM judge.

Evaluating default collapse and steerability loss using multiple-choice survey questions from the Pew American Trends Panel, contrasting the majority positions of 'Very liberal Democrat' versus 'Very conservative Republican'.

Evaluating default collapse and steerability loss using multiple-choice survey questions from the Pew American Trends Panel, contrasting the majority positions of 'Atheist' versus 'Protestant' demographic groups.
